reviews.text: Our friends recommended Man and His Mutt after they had a positive dog sitting experience with them. Our dogs have a lot of special needs- they're reactive with other dogs, somewhat anxious around humans they don't know, and being seniors they have a few health issues we're managing. Finding a pet sitter we felt comfortable handling all of that felt impossible, until we met Alex. Alex is so knowledgeable about dogs, I question whether he was one in a past life. He instantly knew how to handle both my dogs behavioral issues and discussed how the team handles health issues in a way that gave me peace of mind leaving my dogs with him. He knows his team so well that he was able to recommend Caroline as a great fit for my dogs as well. Caroline has watched our dogs twice now and they both absolutely love her. We get pictures throughout the day of them enjoying lots of time outside and snuggles, which we really appreciate. If you have some quirky dogs, it's definitely worth reaching out to Alex to see if he can help. Chances are he can.

We are so lucky to have found Man & His Mutt as our trusted sitters! It took us quite a while to find a team that really “gets” our anxious, reactive dog after it was clear he would be a challenge for previous sitters we interviewed. We were pleased to see how Alex’s background as a trainer fit perfectly with his needs from the get go, and we quickly came to trust Jen and Jake from his awesome team when they covered our later stays as well. From the first meet and greet, both Alex and his teammate Jen built a strong rapport with our dog and were very easy to work with for scheduling, even despite our area being out of the way for them. They followed our every instruction carefully and Jen even took our dog for jogs, which he loved!! We always appreciate getting photo updates from them and a recap of each visit.

We now have the pleasure of working mainly with Jake, who is also a trainer, as the team has grown to include better coverage for our local area. We love that Jake is a great communicator and always makes sure to really love on our pups when we’re away! He welcomes our detailed instructions as well and always checks with us before doing anything not previously discussed. We love getting photos and updates with every visit and we trust that our pups are both in great hands with him every time. On our most recent trip, he even made sure that we would get his updates by sending emails when his texts weren’t going through due to our international phone service. Jake has gone above and beyond many times to make sure our time away is as carefree as possible and we appreciate him so much!!

Thank you to the whole Man & His Mutt team for everything you do to give us and our dogs a great experience. We always joke that our one dog is secretly bummed when we get home because he loves spending time with the team that much. 😉

If I could get them 6 stars, I would!! My husband and I have a 7 year old pit boxer mix. He has stranger danger and is reactive to both people and dogs. He’s also INCREDIBLY anxious to the point where he hid and held in is pee/poop in for 72 hours when someone tried to watch him that wasn’t us. That means finding sitters has always been challenging in every city we’ve lived in. On top of that, we both travel a TON for work and personal travel. When we moved to Philly we found Alex C and his team and it has completely changed our lives. We are able to travel freely and know our dog Milo is safe, happy, and cared for. They’ve helped us expand his circle of trust and he has grown SO much in the past year thanks to them.

Alex took weeks to get to know Milo before the first sit. He was so patient and is an insanely good trainer for anxious and reactive pups. He just really really knows his stuff and always explains the science/facts/history behind his methods, which we particularly love. Alex C introduced us to Alex F on his team to expand his circle and Milo officially fell in love. Our dog is not one to be affectionate or outwardly like any human besides his mom and dad but Alex F is literally the Milo whisperer and we will never use any trainer/sitter ever again!! Alex F is also just so incredibly kind and patient with Milo. We can tell they really do love him and it warms our hearts that we found that, especially for a dog that so many people mark as “aggressive”. When both Alex’s watch Milo they send us tons of updates and make us feel so comfortable. They’re also just such awesome people and so respectful staying in our home when we travel. We trust them implicitly. Just all around good people who know their stuff. We’ve started the journey to advance our training with them as well, including working on reactivity with other dogs, and we also plan to work on training for Milo when we grow our family and have our first baby. They make us feel hopeful and push our boundaries in the best way (I can be a bit conservative with Milo) while also setting our expectations - they’re super balanced and make us feel comfortable each step. We feel so lucky to have found this crew and could not recommend them more ❤️

I love these guys. I do walks and training so far. Jake is great at helping guide me to make my dog neutral with a friend's dog. The first session, we were able to get them 2 ft away. The second session, even when my dog snapped, he was able to correct it and explain why. We were able to take a walk with the other dog after. Im amazed at all the stuff they have accomplished with both my dogs. My dogs were known as aggressive dogs. They are now going up to neighbors and giving them kisses.

Alex is the best! He worked with us and our dog Rockefeller, a nervous reactive pitbull. The training sessions were information-filled and he gave us homework to work on with Rockefeller every week which was super helpful. Rockefeller’s main trouble was with interacting with other dogs appropriately, and Alex was able to build the foundation with him to the point where now Rockefeller is much better at dealing with other dogs. 10/10 would recommend!

I found Alex at Man and His Mutt thru a Facebook group recommendation. We signed up for the standard training sessions with our dog, Spaghetti. Spaghetti is a working dog; reactive on his leash, high energy, prey drive, needs a lot of stimulation, etc.. Alex taught us a variety of training techniques and when to use different marker words to help us manage Spaghetti's tendencies. During our sessions, we ran through many different scenarios that would/could trigger Spaghetti and Alex took us thru step by step on how to manage those scenarios. We learned so much, and Alex went above and beyond in every session. He even scheduled two extra sessions for us to make up for a lack of "prey" triggers on two of our sessions. Through working with Alex, I really gained a deeper understanding and appreciation of Spaghetti. I love Spaghetti's personality even more.. it's what makes him him! Our walks have gotten a lot calmer and we're more confident when we come across other dogs on our walks. We are more in tune with Spaghetti and understand what sort of stimulation he needs and how to manage that..and we truly love and embrace his crazy self! :) Our other dog, Jett, has even benefitted from Spaghetti's new good habits! We also worked with Gabe, Alex's apprentice, during our sessions who was amazing as well! Thank you Alex and Gabe!
Alex's work with our anxious dog has been life altering!! I can't say enough. So thankful for his wisdom and experience in better understanding and caring for our dog.

UPDATE 2026: It’s time to leave another update about how incredible Alex and the Man and His Mutt team are! Alex has continued to make such a dramatic difference in Betty’s life. This weekend we took her to a crowded farmers market and she was able to actually enjoy herself! We ran into friends and hung out for a bit, and they couldn’t believe it. They’d never seen her so calm outside of our house. Keep in mind there used to be times if she heard a car or too many loud street sounds she would relieve herself in fear because of her anxiety and noise phobia 💔

We’re so grateful he and his team are in Betty’s life. Training, walking, sitting, he and everyone on his team are seriously the best, and I can’t believe how much Betty has grown in the last 2.5 years! She’s been able to experience the world so much more. 🥹

2025: Alex is amazing!! We’ve been through two previous trainers for our anxiety and fear filled pup. Working with Alex we’ve made more progress than we ever have. You can tell he’s passionate specifically about training fearful and reactive dogs, and I’m so happy our Betty has been able to conquer some of her fears, slowly but surely. I can’t recommend him highly enough!!

We had a great experience helping to train US - to be able to train our puppy Elliott. Alex was awesome - we talked about what our priorities were as a family (minimizing jumping, puppy biting, leash behavior, recall, car anxiety and introductions to other dogs among the top ones), and through the 6 lesson package - I feel like we learned a lot about how our dog thinks / why he behaves the way he does / what cues he take from us.

It was great to have trained dogs to interact with Elliott so we could learn what behaviors to look for - in a more controlled environment. We also even started doing some scent work for gluten detection!

Alex was great, personable, knowledgable, and willing to listen and really help work with us and our dog - not just a generic generalized plan of checking the boxes. Highly recommended!

Jake is the trainer we worked with for 6 sessions. Our dog Maddy is VERY excitable and also reactive to other dogs/animals. We’ve learned so much in every session and have gained all the tools we need to continue our on-going training. Jake is the sweetest guy you’ll meet, our dog is crazy go nuts about him, and we felt very understood and supported the entire time. He also let us train our dog with his two dogs during a few sessions which was extremely helpful. We are a much happier and healthier family thanks to Jake’s assistance. Thank you, Jake!!!!!

Alex has been amazing at training our 4 year old rescue who had no prior obedience or behavioral training. He's been very accommodating to the reactivity issues our dog has and personalizes training to the needs of the dog. He also does amazing with walks when we need them and sends great updates and photos after each walk! Alex has gone above and beyond and I highly recommend him, especially if you are working through difficult behavioral issues with your dog.

Alex and Levi are amazing for dog sitting! Their depth of knowledge is evident from the very first time you meet. My reactive dog adores them and was on her best behavior because she wanted them to come back. 10/10!

Alex and crew are top notch.  He is a dog whisperer and understands dogs intellectually and intuitively.  He also communicates very effectively and teaches you how to integrate the behavioral techniques into your family's routine.  He is reliable, hard working and simply excellent at what he does.  Arielle has been an incredible addition to the team. She has continued to reinforce better behavior on walks and when boarding our Bernedoodle this past weekend,  showed him so much love and we couldn't have been more at ease, knowing that she was taking care of him as if he was her own puppy. The team truly feels as if they are part of our family!

Alex’s sessions are amazing.  His credentials are top tier.  And he is the ultimate professional: he is friendly to both dog and human.  The sessions are structured but flexible: ranging from introductions, to public spaces and other dogs.  One of his many strengths is that he focuses on communication:  teaching me how to read my dog read me.  This taught me a lot of patience for my puppy, and also I learned that when I’m calm, my pup is calm.  Also, I learned how to interact with other dogs and people in different situations that used to lead to less stress and uncertainty for my pup! Best of all he also teaches without judgement, so the experience is fun and rewarding for both me and the dog.  I highly recommend him for all training and other canine needs.

We are so happy with Alex and his training! Our 8 month puppy Benny got some intensive training and care from Man and his Mutt and we are all so happy with the results. Highly recommend working with Alex and his team. Our dog loves him too and we will continue work with dog walking and pet sitting!

Alex Cost is a superb trainer. Hire him! He can solve issues with pushy dogs, which my pit bull mix is, improving the human-animal connection. He is a patient instructor and worked on in-home barking, my dog ‘going to his bed’, meeting new people, leash skills, as well as reactivity training outside around other dogs.
We worked too on implicit cues, e.g. the dog owner presents a dog with enough opportunities to learn a command, such as approaching the front door and sitting, but without saying a word. It takes patience; however, developing canine focus, not control, aids in harmonious relations and in a dog knowing whom to look to when unsure, namely his human.
I would trust Alex with all my animals. His expertise shines through. He is completely devoted to creating the best outcomes for pets and owners. He will meet you where you are and then educate you gently, persistently and effectively. I learned so much.
Dog training is never done and I know my dog has an advocate in Alex, who really can answer all questions and guide you both to master skills. He has a sense of humor, too, and sessions never pass without learning something new. Do you know what an extinction burst is?
Ask Alex, the Expert Canine Behaviorist!

Alex is THE BEST at what he does. I have four dogs one of which is the baby of the family and needed a lot of beginner training. Alex quickly helped guide us into learning training techniques to master those obedience skills.
My other pup, Ghosty, on the other hand is a COVID baby and also had a rough start in life. He is reactive to both people and animals. It was a slowwww moving process with Ghost. I previously had another dog trainer that stated that he was a pro at dealing with reactivity, but that ended in quite a disappointment. I tried many people and nobody wanted to help due to the level of reactivity that they got from Ghost. It got to the point where I had given up on trying to help him.. until I met Alex. He worked with my partner and I to understand Ghosty and help him with his trauma. It has been a long road and we will always have work to do to give him the life that he deserves, but we truly feel more confident in the process and Alex is the sole reason for this!

Alex is excellent! He is very professional and friendly, and the animals love him! We have one dog that is particularly difficult and standoffish, but in no time Alex had befriend her, becoming best friends by the end of our vacation! I cannot recommend Alex enough!

Alex is the BEST. He is our go to favorite sitter to stay with our small zoo. With 3 dogs, 5 cats and a bearded dragon, it’s a big job.  We always come home to happy stress free animals. Alex is the only person outside of our immediate family to watch our very scared dog. He showed her such kindness and patience while respecting her strict boundaries. She even warmed up to him after a couple days which is basically unheard of. Alex also came to the rescue when we forgot some important items for our wedding! He’s an amazing human who is so warm and loving. We feel lucky to have him!

Alex is a dog whisperer! Before working with him, taking my dog to public places where other dogs might be around was stressful because I never knew when she would start a fight. He taught me how to understand her body language and handle her better during interactions. Thanks to his help, an off-leash dog recently ran up to us in the park and instead of reacting aggressively, she was friendly and playful! I never thought I’d feel this much peace of mind taking her to public places.

My old Shiba girl is very particular and can be really nervous in new situations, but she LOVES Alex and is clearly very comfortable with him. I highly recommend Man & His Mutt for dog training and dog sitting! 💕 …

Alex is amazing!!!! 10/10!!!

I was incredibly anxious and frustrated by my dog’s often inappropriate engagement with people and other dogs.  I was about to put him on medication but was so worried he’d be a shadow of himself.  We’d done trainings before but were still having issues. I decided to give training one last go.  I’ve had multiple dogs including Germans Shepherds but my current little buddy was incredibly frustrating.

I first came across Man and His Mutt via google while frantically trying to figure out what to do after a less than ideal incident leaving me in tears.  I then had an opportunity to meet Alex at Dog Days of Summer.  He was incredibly kind and patient.  We worked with over a few months and my dog has never been better! We get compliments from people who knew our dog prior! I feel like my dog can live the life he deserves!

Even more so, Alex helped me realize part of my anxiety was coming from not understanding how to communicate with my dog and that the anxiety was stemming from the fact my dog was selectively reactive leading to seemingly unpredictable behavior.  He helped us set realistic expectations and taught us so much about our sweet boy.  He even told us about a reactive dog walk and helped walk our little buddy!  We will be continuing to use him for walking and spot training sessions to continue working on smaller behavioral issues.

Every dog needs “hotdog man” in their life!

Alex is a fantastic dog trainer and help overall !! His ability with animals is amazing. well prepared for any event, kind and gentle with your dog  and genuinely cares about them and will not give up. He’s willing to go the extra mile , I trust his judgment and so does my dog !!
Alex is very knowledgeable, helpful, and goes above and beyond to help you and your dog! He clearly loves doggos and i unhesitatingly recommend him to everyone.
I had a great experience with Alex. He did walking training with my puppy and was also available to show me some techniques to train at home. I would recommend for leash training!

Alex is a tremendous caretaker when it comes to dogs. He’s incredibly knowledgeable and freely shares wisdom on training, behavior, best practices.
He’s patient and consistent with dogs (regardless of their temperament and abilities), clearly exhibiting both passion and experience for what he does. I’d trust him with anyone’s dog!

Alex is the best! He is everything you would hope for and more — incredibly effective with all kinds of dogs (we have a lil ball of energy under 20 pounds, a stubborn bulldog with supreme separation anxiety, and a great dane with some …

Alex is wonderful! He was patient and knowledgeable about my leash reactive pup and helped me learn how to manage my dog, myself. His goal is to help you become your own dogs trainer. Not to be reliant on others for your dogs whole life! He …
